message_flow: End users opt in by visiting https://www.emmiwood.com/emmiwood/book and entering their mobile number. They may optionally check a box agreeing to receive appointment confirmation, reminder, and update texts from Emmiwood Barbers. Consent is not required to complete a booking. The opt-in checkbox and disclosures are documented at https://www.emmiwood.com/emmiwood/opt-in-evidence/ (static evidence page). Privacy Policy: https://www.emmiwood.com/emmiwood/privacy (states that mobile phone numbers and messaging consent are not shared, sold, or provided to third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes). SMS Terms: https://www.emmiwood.com/emmiwood/sms-terms (frequency, rates, STOP, and HELP). Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Customers reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help. KUP Solutions operates the booking and SMS technology for Emmiwood Barbers as a service provider (registered Sole Proprietor brand) and is not a marketing affiliate. Staff admin one-time passcodes are sent only to allowlisted administrator mobile numbers for portal security, not marketing.

description: This campaign sends transactional SMS for Emmiwood Barbers customers and staff on a KUP-hosted booking system. Messages include booking confirmations, appointment reminders, reschedule and cancellation notices for customers who opt in during online booking, and one-time staff sign-in codes for allowlisted shop administrators. Messages are not used for marketing or promotional offers.
